card.name: The before health care provider roles
card.fires_on: The word "the" (or "for") right before a prescriber or health care provider, in advice to alert or report behavior changes such as suicidality or compulsive behaviors.

modes.label: Alert the provider
modes.description: "the" after "alert" or "report ... to", just before health care provider or treating physician.
modes.example: Counsel family members or caregivers of patients to monitor for changes in behavior and to alert<< the>> health care provider.

modes.label: Prescriber as next subject
modes.description: "for" or "the" where the next word is prescriber, in warnings about behaviors the patient may not notice.
